statement: One named executive is accountable for the outcome of the recommended path and holds authority over both its budget and its roadmap priority.
The accountable executive expects to remain in role for at least the next 18 months.
source: Org review item 15; combined with GV01 by minimum

statement: Funding for the first 12 months of the recommended path is committed (not only approved in principle), including running old and new in parallel where applicable.
A share of engineering capacity for the recommended path is agreed in writing with product leadership.
attested_by: Technology lead and head of product

statement: A named owner and a staffing plan exist for maintaining the current system until the parts being changed are retired.
applies_to: outcomes that retire or move parts of the estate

statement: Baseline delivery and reliability measures (lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, time to restore) have been measured in the last six months.
Each phase has two or three outcome measures, each with a baseline, a target and a business owner.
Checkpoints and explicit criteria for pausing, re-scoping or stopping have been agreed.
applies_to: all programme outcomes; mandatory if G14 = yes

statement: Change-control requirements (e.g. change advisory board, regulatory sign-off) allow a team to deploy its part on its own, or a route to change them has been agreed with risk and compliance.
Constraints on where systems may be hosted (data residency, sovereignty, sector regulation) have been assessed in writing.
A documented and tested exit plan exists for the hosting provider(s) of the recommended path.
source: EU DORA Art. 28; EBA outsourcing guidelines

statement: No more than one other major change (reorganisation, new core system, merger) will significantly affect the same teams in the next 12 months.
applies_to: all programme outcomes; corroborated by survey G10
